metadata.scene_title: Batch Viral Search Plus Deep Teardown
metadata.title: Scene 03 Report - lip combo US

working_context.summary: Analyze viral lip combo videos in the US market and extract repeatable creation rules.
minimum_evidence: A ranked or rankable candidate pool
ideal_evidence: Links plus screenshots or transcript notes
constraints: Conclusions must be backed by supplied links or screenshots
ready_checklist: Top 3-5 videos have enough evidence for teardown

executive_summary.conclusion: The strongest lip combo videos win by showing the final lip look immediately, then proving ease and shade payoff within the next 5 seconds.
executive_summary.why_it_matters: This pattern favors fast cosmetic proof over slow education, which should shape hook design and shot order.
executive_summary.next_action: Build three new variants that keep the instant final-look reveal but test different credibility signals.

operator_checklist: Shortlist first, then deep-teardown only the top set.
Use the same lens across all chosen videos so patterns are comparable.
End with reusable creation rules, not only observations.
common_failure_modes: Deep-analyzing weak candidates that should have been filtered out earlier.
Using different teardown criteria across videos.
Summarizing patterns without enough per-video evidence.

execution_template.recommended_request: Run scene 03 to shortlist the strongest viral candidates for one topic, then deeply tear down only the top set. Finish with shared creation rules that can be used immediately for new scripts.
execution_template.recommended_request_zh: 按场景 03 执行：先对同一主题的候选热视频做 shortlist，再只深拆前几条强样本，最后沉淀共享爆点规律和可直接改写成新脚本的创作规则。

variable_inputs.name: market
variable_inputs.meaning: Target market or locale for the candidate pool

variable_inputs.name: evidence_pack
variable_inputs.meaning: Links, screenshots, transcripts, or copied notes used as source evidence
variable_inputs.example: 10 candidate TikTok links with screenshots and transcript notes

variable_inputs.name: success_goal
variable_inputs.meaning: What the operator wants this scene to produce
variable_inputs.example: Shortlist plus per-video teardown and creation rules

codex_prompt_scaffold: Use scene 03 as the governing workflow.
Normalize the candidate pool before doing deep teardown.
If evidence is missing, state the gap explicitly before continuing.
Produce a ranked shortlist, per-video teardown, shared pattern summary, and creation rules.
Use the same teardown lens across all shortlisted videos so the comparison stays valid.
codex_prompt_scaffold_zh: 按场景 03 执行：先对同一主题的候选热视频做 shortlist，再只深拆前几条强样本，最后沉淀共享爆点规律和可直接改写成新脚本的创作规则。
先把我提供的材料整理成这组输入：Keyword or topic, Target market, Candidate links or search results, Desired sample size。
如果证据不足，先明确缺口再继续。最低开工证据：One keyword or topic, A candidate pool to rank。
最终必须产出：Shortlist, Per-video teardown, Shared pattern summary, Creation rules。
输出必须可直接给运营、拆解、脚本、测试或交付使用，优先给表格、排序逻辑、复用规则和下一步动作。
workflow_steps: Deep-teardown only the top set with the same analysis lens.
End with reusable creation rules and the next production move.
output_checklist: The top set is explicitly shortlisted before deep teardown.
Each chosen video is analyzed with the same fields.
The report ends with reusable creation rules, not only observations.

sections.heading: Executive Conclusion
paragraphs: The category is not winning on novelty alone. It is winning on immediately visible transformation plus proof of shade harmony.
bullets: First-frame beauty payoff matters more than creator introduction.
Viewers need both aspiration and evidence in the same short window.

sections.heading: Structure Logic
numbered: Open with the final lip result before any setup.
Show the two or three products in use quickly.
Use a close-up proof shot that confirms texture and color blend.
End with a simple recommendation or shade logic.

table.title: Top Candidate Shortlist
rows: Finished lip look in first second
Product names plus close-up blend shot
Strong proof of payoff and ease

sections.heading: Reusable Formula
paragraphs: Final look first -> product reveal -> blend proof -> simple shade logic -> light CTA.
bullets: Do not delay the payoff with a long spoken intro.
Do not over-explain ingredient claims in the first 5 seconds.
